body: The kind icons (🛒, ✓, 💶) differ in width, so the names after them start at different positions. Give the icon a fixed-width, centred slot on list cards and invitation cards: web a .kind-icon class (inline-block, 1.5em, centred, no shrink), Android a shared KindIcon composable 28dp wide with centred text. Same across all account sections.
title: Overview: the list-kind icon sits in a fixed-width column so list names align (both clients)
